subject.title: Isolated cron consistently fails with "LLM request failed" on model-call-started phase

question: For the remaining isolated-cron failure family, should maintainers prioritize the focused watchdog progress fix, the stream-progress/provider timeout path, or a broader session-reset recovery policy?
rationale: Current main has partial fixes and open canonical subcases, while the new session-reset proposal changes recovery semantics that source inspection alone cannot safely choose.

options.title: Land focused canonical fixes first
options.body: Review and land or reject #93914/#93912 and continue #91892 as the stream-progress tracker before adding any new recovery behavior.

options.title: Design session reset policy
options.body: Define when consecutive cron errors should reset isolated-session state, then add live upgrade-safe proof before implementation.

options.title: Collapse to narrower trackers
options.body: Close this broad parent only after explicitly moving all remaining user evidence to #91892 and #93912.

recommendation.title: Land focused canonical fixes first
recommendation.body: Review and land or reject #93914/#93912 and continue #91892 as the stream-progress tracker before adding any new recovery behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent cron/runtime release-line work makes this the best routing owner among the available history signals.
